name: list_postgres_slow_query_patterns
description: Lists the slowest query patterns observed on a Postgres service in a time window, with aggregate metrics per pattern (call count, total/avg/p50/p95/p99/max duration, rows, shared buffer cache hits and reads, CPU time, WAL bytes, error count). Durations are in microseconds. Use this first to find which queries dominate execution time, CPU, I/O, or WAL, then pass a selected pattern queryId, dbName, dbUser, dbOperation, and app exactly as returned to get_postgres_slow_query_pattern_details for its recent executions. Pass app as an empty string when the selected pattern has no application_name; omit the app filter only when intentionally querying across all applications. The queryText is normalized with $1-style placeholders.

app.description: Filter to a Postgres application_name. Pass an empty string to filter to queries with no application_name; omit to include all applications.

dbName.description: Only include patterns that ran in this database, matching the dbName of returned patterns.

dbOperation.description: Only include patterns with this top-level SQL operation type, such as SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or UTILITY, matching the dbOperation of returned patterns.

dbUser.description: Only include patterns executed by this database user, matching the dbUser of returned patterns.

fromDate.description: Inclusive start of the time window. Pass a UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, e.g. 2026-06-08T00:00:00.000Z.

limit.description: Number of patterns per page. Omit for the default page of 20; use offset and the totalCount in the result to page further.

offset.description: Number of patterns to skip before the first returned pattern. Omit to start from the top-ranked pattern.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the Postgres service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

serviceId.description: Managed Postgres service to analyze. Use the id of a postgres-type service returned by get_services_list.

sortBy.description: Aggregate metric that ranks the patterns. Omit to rank by total_duration, which surfaces the patterns that consume the most execution time.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Omit for descending, which puts the heaviest patterns first.

toDate.description: Inclusive end of the time window, evaluated at minute granularity. Pass a UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, e.g. 2026-06-09T00:00:00.000Z.
